quarterly_data.signal: Datacom R&D projects (annual report, in-progress project table): the datacom micro-optics lens development project (expected total investment RMB 630.00 ten-thousand; RMB 473.56 ten-thousand invested in 2025, RMB 630.03 ten-thousand cumulative) has completed the micro-lens thermal-forming process and material system, and industry customers are gradually adopting it; it targets cost-effective, durable micro-lenses and lens arrays for datacom modules. The silicon-etched micro-prism / lens angle connector development project (RMB 320.00 ten-thousand; RMB 79.97 ten-thousand invested) is developing one- and two-dimensional prism-lens array devices for datacom; the product design has been accepted by the customer and it is at the initial sample delivery stage.
